issues.explanation: editor_note_fa names only INSO 42001 cl.3.5, but the entry carries definitions from two distinct standards (also INSO 23728 cl.3.1.29). A reader consulting only the note would believe a single source was consulted and miss that the two definitions differ in substance.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace editor_note_fa with: «اصطلاح تعریف‌شده در INSO 42001 بند 3.5 و INSO 23728 بند 3.1.29؛ بازبینی‌نشده.»

issues.explanation: The standard prints «مخاطره (ریسک) حریم خصوصی» — with the loanword gloss in parentheses — as the term_fa. Rule 1 requires preferred_fa to equal the printed form. The proposed preferred_fa «مخاطرهٔ حریم خصوصی» strips the parenthetical and demotes the full printed form to an alias, which inverts the required hierarchy.
issues.suggested_fix: Set preferred_fa to «مخاطره (ریسک) حریم خصوصی» (the printed form). «مخاطره حریم خصوصی» and «ریسک حریم خصوصی» may remain as aliases.

issues.explanation: The current preferred_fa carries an ezafeh marker: «مخاطرهٔ». A standalone headword entry should use the base citation form «مخاطره» without the construct-state mark.
issues.suggested_fix: Change «مخاطرهٔ» to «مخاطره» in the preferred_fa field.

issues.explanation: The standard prints «بافت تنظیم‌گری (رگولاتوری)» as the term_fa. The proposed preferred_fa «بافت تنظیم‌گری» silently drops the loanword parenthetical and moves the full printed form to alternatives_fa. Per Rule 1 the preferred must match what the standard prints; per Rule 4 official forms are kept as printed even if unusual.
issues.suggested_fix: Set preferred_fa to «بافت تنظیم‌گری (رگولاتوری)». «بافت تنظیم‌گری» (without parenthetical) may remain as an alias.
